findings.summary: The bridge still reads as primitive deck geometry with disconnected stair chunks rather than a coherent authored crossing.
The 2.3km water surface has insufficient mesh density for its wave frequency and lacks convincing shore/depth treatment.
Current coverage validates the water mesh but not bidirectional player traversal, dry deck behavior, or rail collision.
Path overlays still use hard-edged fixed-height planes and visibly break at bridge approaches.
